physweapon._about: PHYSWEAPON v106 (lanePHYSWEAPON), read by Scripts/Physics/PhysWeapon.cs. PRESENTATION ONLY: nothing here is read by the 60 Hz sim; the simhash must be identical ON and OFF. Master 'enabled' and every sub-switch ship FALSE (dark = today's behaviour, no object created, no event subscribed). Needs the physics master + clock ON (same gate as finphys). Flip with apply_physweapon.py --enable clash|pin|severed|debris|props (only after Dom's LOOK OK). Command line: -physweapon:off, -physweapon:probe (logs where the weapon tips sit, once). weapons[]: the weapon as a capsule socket -> TrailTip + extendM (radiusM), plus an optional head sphere at TrailTip (headRadiusM): numbers MEASURED from the weapon glb vertex data (see MANIFEST section 3), not guessed; the default sword's extendM is UNVERIFIED in the engine until the probe runs. clash: sparks = ClashFx / HitFeel spark origin at the real contact point (needs the two apply hunks; enable only ONE of this and arc_fx sparks.on), sparkMaxFromBodyM = never farther than this from the old body anchor; blend = fallback blend of the two tips when the blades do not touch; maxGapM = surfaces closer than this count as a true touch; leverMaxM = the impulse point is never farther than this from the arm part's centre of mass (torque limit). pin: run_through blade stays in the body: entries = finishers.json ids; part = ragdoll.json part the blade holds; spring/damper/maxForceN = joint drive; released when the blade withdraws releaseDistM or after maxHoldS. severed: tunes by unit id (head, torso_waist, crown = the split halves): spin about the blow, centre-of-mass drop, bounce/friction/damping; headPhysics = head unit mode physics instead of V1FIN's scripted arc. debris: pooled floor chips (rows by event type; finisher = at a finisher contact). props: scene objects by exact name that become bodies when a contact lands within radiusM (never statically batched or bigger than maxSizeM).

weapons.note: maul_start_LOD0.glb vertex data: shaft radius 0.04 (y -0.3..0.3), head y 0.30..0.70 (centre 0.50 = the glb tip node y 0.522), head half-width x 0.26 z -0.19..0.29. pitborn_maul_joan_LOD0.glb: head y 0.40..0.70 centre 0.55 = its tip/head node 0.548. TrailTip is at the head centre; extendM 0.20 = head half height.

sword_start_LOD0.glb: blade to y 0.996 = the glb tip node; BuildSlice put TrailTip at tipY 0.6147 (62 percent of the blade), so extendM 0.38 reaches the glb tip. UNVERIFIED in the engine (the scene is binary): run -physweapon:probe; set 0 if TrailTip already sits at the point.

fallback.note: any other weapon: socket to TrailTip
